name: DTALab
university: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia
address: Via Pietro Vivarelli, 10, 41125 Modena MO, Italy
about: DTALab (Data and Text Analytics Laboratory) is a research group at the Department of Engineering "Enzo Ferrari" of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia. We conduct cutting-edge research at the intersection of data management, machine learning, and natural language processing. Our work spans entity matching, data integration, text analytics, and big data analytics.
